name: In Nightmares
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 10 instead of 15. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, adventurer, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can...

Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Circle is who you need to find. Head to Darnassus. I cannot say more.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...<Mathrengyl peers into the shard>Oh... I didn't... Well.adventurer, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that the Cenarion druids alone must attend to.Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
narrative.requestItemsText: May I help you with something?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 25 to 26, 7,150 XP in all.

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard. Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

quests.name: In Nightmares
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
